name: 零售陈列架 / 展示道具（示例：换产品只需复制这个文件改内容）
offer: We design and manufacture custom countertop displays, floor displays and shelf-ready trays in cardboard, acrylic and wood, from 3D render and sample to bulk.
ideal_customers: cosmetics and nail polish brands selling through boutiques and pharmacies
snack, confectionery and beverage brands entering retail
eyewear, phone accessory and small electronics brands with retail partners
craft beer, spirits and specialty food brands with shop placements
markets: USA, Canada, UK, Germany, France, Netherlands, Australia
concept_library:
Display types (A and B must differ):
- countertop display unit (CDU) with header card
- floor-standing display unit (FSDU) with 3-5 shelves
- shelf-ready tray / PDQ with tear-away front
- acrylic countertop riser with logo base
- rotating spinner display
- dump bin for loose items
- wooden crate-style display
Materials and finishes: printed corrugated, white or kraft board, clear/frosted acrylic, oak veneer, LED edge-lit header, magnetic graphic panels.
design_guidance: Choose by product size, number of SKUs/facings, retail channel and how shoppers pick the item. Use the brand colours. Show product facings realistically filled.
email_extra: Never give prices, lead times or certifications. Concepts are for discussion and need a sample.
subject_examples: two counter display ideas for your lip oils
cta_examples: If one fits your retail plans, reply A or B with roughly how many stores and I'll send pricing and a sample timeline.

image.prompt:
Photorealistic retail display presentation, landscape, two display concepts side by side for the same product.

PRODUCT (keep it exactly like the reference photo; do not redesign it): {product}.

LEFT - concept "A": {a_structure}. {a_visual}
RIGHT - concept "B": {b_structure}. {b_visual}

Both displays filled with the product in a clean modern shop setting. The brand name "{brand}" appears on each display header, spelled exactly. No other words.

Small letters "A" and "B" near the top of each half. Small footer text: "{footer}".

Scene: {scene}. Bright retail lighting, catalogue photography, both concepts fully in frame.

followup.body:
Hi {brand} team,

Quick follow-up on the two display ideas for {product} - happy to tweak sizes or send a sample.

Would A or B be worth a quote?
